title: Print-to-Program Pipeline — Upload Print → Get CNC Program
reconcile_note: KILO-P2P-RECONCILE-MS0/U-KP2P-04 (2026-05-22, ADVISORY, mustHumanVerify): 4 of 12 units flipped not_started→complete after on-disk verification (engine exists + dispatcher-wired + tests). 8 units remain genuine pending backlog. Full per-unit verdict: state/shared/specs/KILO-P2P-CLOSEOUT-RECONCILE-2026-05-22.md.
description: Build the crown jewel pipeline: User uploads engineering print (PDF/photo/DXF) or CAD file → system extracts features → selects tools FROM USER'S INVENTORY → generates operation sequence → calculates physics-backed S/F → assembles CNC program with correct post for their machine → generates setup sheet + cost estimate + ROI suggestions for upgrades. Two paths: (1) Print→CAD→CAM→Program (full reconstruction), (2) Print→Program (direct using templates + user library).

units.title: PrintToGeometryEngine — 2D Drawing → 3D CadQuery Model
units.reconcile_note: KILO-P2P-RECONCILE-MS0/U-KP2P-04 (2026-05-22, ADVISORY mustHumanVerify): flipped not_started→complete — PrintToGeometryEngine.ts on disk + 1 dispatcher reference + 2 test files. See state/shared/specs/KILO-P2P-CLOSEOUT-RECONCILE-2026-05-22.md.
units.description: New engine that takes BlueprintOCR output (extracted dimensions, features, GD&T) and generates a CadQuery Python script that creates the 3D solid model. Uses feature-driven modeling: holes→cylinders, pockets→subtract boxes, bosses→extrude, chamfers→chamfer ops. Handles prismatic parts (mill/turn profiles). Outputs CadQuery script + estimated geometry envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Output: { cadquery_script: string, features: Feature[], envelope: BoundingBox, confidence: number }
Handles: rectangular parts, cylindrical parts, parts with holes/pockets/slots/chamfers
Uses CadQuery primitives: box, cylinder, hole, pocket, chamfer, fillet, shell
Tests: ≥5 (simple plate with holes, shaft with keyway, bracket, boss, complex prismatic)

units.title: InventoryAwareToolSelectorEngine — Match Features to User's Tools
units.reconcile_note: KILO-P2P-RECONCILE-MS0/U-KP2P-04 (2026-05-22, ADVISORY mustHumanVerify): flipped not_started→complete — InventoryAwareToolSelectorEngine.ts on disk + 3 dispatcher references + 3 test files. See state/shared/specs/KILO-P2P-CLOSEOUT-RECONCILE-2026-05-22.md.
units.description: New engine that takes a feature list + user's tool library and finds the BEST available tools from what the user actually owns. Falls back to catalog recommendations for missing tools with 'you need to buy this' suggestions. Considers: tool condition (worn tools get derating), holder compatibility, machine magazine capacity, tool change minimization.
acceptance_criteria: Input: { features: Feature[], user_tools: UserTool[], machine: MachineProfile, preferences: { optimize_for: string } }

Output: { tool_assignments: Array<{ feature, tool, from_inventory: boolean, confidence }>, missing_tools: Array<{ feature, recommended_tool, estimated_cost, buy_link? }>, magazine_layout: ToolSlot[], tool_changes: number }
Integrates with UserToolLibraryEngine for user's actual inventory
Derates worn tools (reduces recommended S/F by condition factor)
Suggests tool consolidation (one tool for multiple features when possible)
Tests: ≥5 (full inventory match, partial inventory, empty inventory, worn tools, tool consolidation)

units.title: ROIAdvisorEngine — Upgrade Suggestions with Payback Analysis
units.reconcile_note: KILO-P2P-RECONCILE-MS0/U-KP2P-04 (2026-05-22, ADVISORY mustHumanVerify): flipped not_started→complete — ROIAdvisorEngine.ts on disk + 1 dispatcher reference + 2 test files. See state/shared/specs/KILO-P2P-CLOSEOUT-RECONCILE-2026-05-22.md.
units.description: New engine that analyzes the gap between user's current inventory/machine capabilities and optimal setup, then suggests purchases with ROI justification. Considers: tool cost vs per-part savings, machine upgrade vs outsourcing, holder upgrades (shrink fit vs ER collet), coolant upgrades (flood vs MQL vs through-tool). Calculates payback period based on user's part volume.
acceptance_criteria: Input: { current_setup: { tools, machine, holders }, optimal_setup: { tools, machine, holders }, annual_volume: number, current_cycle_time_min: number, current_tool_cost_per_part: number }
Output: { suggestions: Array<{ item, current, recommended, cost, savings_per_part, payback_parts, payback_months, priority }>, total_investment, total_annual_savings, overall_roi_pct }
Categories: tool_upgrade, holder_upgrade, machine_upgrade, coolant_upgrade, workholding_upgrade
Calculates: cycle time reduction, tool life improvement, quality improvement, scrap reduction
Tests: ≥4 (tool upgrade ROI, machine upgrade ROI, mixed upgrades, break-even analysis)

units.title: PrintToProgramPipelineEngine — Master Orchestrator
units.reconcile_note: KILO-P2P-RECONCILE-MS0/U-KP2P-04 (2026-05-22, ADVISORY mustHumanVerify): flipped not_started→complete — PrintToProgramPipelineEngine.ts on disk (143.7K) + wired in camDispatcher (print_to_program_full/_enhanced/_plan/_validate, confirmed by U-KP2P-02 P2P-WIRING-MATRIX) + 20 test files. This is the silent close-out debt named in the KILO-P2P-RECONCILE-MS0 brief. See state/shared/specs/KILO-P2P-CLOSEOUT-RECONCILE-2026-05-22.md.
units.description: Master pipeline engine that chains: BlueprintOCR → PrintToGeometry → FeatureRecognition → InventoryAwareToolSelector → OperationSequencer → SpeedFeedOrchestrator → CNCProgramAssembler → PostProcessorPipeline → SetupSheet → QuoteEstimator → ROIAdvisor. Single entry point with progress tracking and partial results. Two modes: (1) 'full' — complete pipeline, (2) 'direct' — skip CAD generation (user provides features or G-code template).
acceptance_criteria: Input: { print_file?: Buffer, cad_file?: Buffer, features?: Feature[], machine: string, user_tool_library_id?: string, quantity: number, optimize_for: 'productivity'|'tool_life'|'cost'|'quality' }
Output: { gcode_program: string, setup_sheet: SetupSheet, cost_estimate: QuoteResult, roi_suggestions: ROISuggestion[], pipeline_log: StageResult[], total_confidence: number }
Chains 10 engines with error handling per stage
Partial results available (if CAD generation fails, still provides feature analysis)
Progress callback for UI progress bar
Tests: ≥3 (full pipeline, direct mode, partial failure recovery)

units.title: PhotoToBlueprint Bridge — Camera/Phone Photo Processing
units.description: Engine that pre-processes phone/camera photos of prints: deskew, contrast enhancement, perspective correction, OCR quality improvement. Outputs clean image suitable for BlueprintOCREngine. Uses: Hough transform for edge detection, perspective warp, adaptive thresholding.
acceptance_criteria: Output: { cleaned_image: Buffer, orientation: 'portrait'|'landscape', confidence: number, warnings: string[] }
Handles: rotation correction, perspective warp, contrast enhancement

units.title: CADFileImportEngine — STEP/IGES/DXF Direct Import
units.description: Engine that parses CAD file formats (STEP AP203/AP214, IGES, DXF) and extracts feature geometry directly. For STEP/IGES: uses text parsing for simple solids (B-rep face extraction). For DXF: entity parsing (LINE, ARC, CIRCLE, LWPOLYLINE). Outputs feature list compatible with PartGeometryPipelineEngine.
acceptance_criteria: Supported: DXF (2D entities → feature inference), STEP (limited B-rep → bounding box + basic features)
Output: { features: Feature[], material_hint?: string, units: 'mm'|'inch', bounding_box: BoundingBox }
DXF: extracts circles as holes, rectangles as pockets, polylines as profiles
STEP: extracts planar faces, cylindrical faces, bounding box (basic level)
Tests: ≥4 (DXF with holes, DXF with pockets, simple STEP, format detection)

units.title: Pipeline Web Page — /pipeline Route
units.description: Create the Pipeline page in the web app. Multi-step wizard: (1) Upload (print PDF/photo/CAD file or describe part), (2) Review extracted features, (3) Select machine from user's machines, (4) Review tool assignments from inventory, (5) Review operation sequence + S/F, (6) Generate program + setup sheet + quote, (7) ROI suggestions. Each step shows results and allows edits before proceeding.
acceptance_criteria: Tool assignment table (inventory tools highlighted, missing tools flagged)
Full pipeline: types + API + hook + page

units.title: Pipeline Backend Route + API Client
units.description: Create Express route /api/v1/pipeline with endpoints for each pipeline stage + full pipeline run. Multipart file upload support.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints: POST /upload (multipart), POST /analyze, POST /tools, POST /sequence, POST /program, POST /full-pipeline

units.title: User Machine Registry — Save My Machines
units.description: Allow users to register their specific machines (model, controller, spindle, magazine slots, tooling). Persisted via UserMachineRegistryEngine. UI: machine cards on Settings page.
acceptance_criteria: Data: machine_name, model, controller, max_rpm, max_power_kw, taper, magazine_slots, registered_tools[]
Settings page updated with 'My Machines' section

units.title: Template Library — Common Part Programs
units.description: Curated library of common part program templates (plate with holes, shaft, bracket, housing, flange) that users can customize. Accelerates the Print→Program path by pre-filling typical features/operations.
acceptance_criteria: Templates: flat_plate, shaft, bracket, housing, flange, bushing, spacer, adapter_plate, angle_bracket, mounting_block (10 minimum)
Each template: default features, operations, typical materials, S/F ranges

units.title: Pipeline History & Learning
units.description: Save pipeline runs with actual results. Track: predicted vs actual cycle time, tool life, scrap rate. Use FeedbackPersistenceEngine to improve future predictions.
acceptance_criteria: Predicted vs actual tracking (user enters actual after running job)
Calibration suggestions based on prediction accuracy

units.title: Pipeline Integration Tests
units.description: End-to-end integration tests for the full pipeline. Test with sample prints/parts through complete flow.
acceptance_criteria: Tests: full pipeline (print→program), direct mode (features→program), photo mode, CAD import mode, inventory-constrained mode
